title: TenancyLocationUpdatedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.location.updated` version 1: a location's profile, settings, fulfilment, listing, pause, pictures or typed fields changed. The envelope's `partner_id` is the location's partner. The payload names the members that changed, never their values. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner of the location, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

changed.description: The names of the location's members that changed, never their values.
